complexity.notes: No hash structures are used, so worst case equals average case. Minor style point: membership test against a list literal works but a set or string like '({[' would be more idiomatic; also the elif chain pops eagerly, which is correct here but a dict mapping closers to openers would be cleaner.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket pop and verify it matches the corresponding opener; the string is valid iff the stack ends empty.
